items.subject: us-history
items.title: Colonial America Unit Bundle
items.summary: A complete U.S. History unit on colonial America for grades 9-12.
items.description:
Colonial America Unit Bundle is a complete U.S. History unit for grades 9-12. The cover marks it for South Carolina USHC Standard 1.

Nine lessons start with who lived in North America before Europeans arrived. Lesson 1, Before 1492, asks who lived there and how they lived. Lesson 3, Jamestown and the Chesapeake: Survival, Tobacco and Bound Labor, follows that colony. A checkpoint uses John White’s 1585 drawing, The Town of Secoton, and asks what the corn fields, the dance circle, and the fire show about planning.

The bundle includes nine lessons, an 8-bit slide deck and a plain-font slide deck, student packets, a DBQ, and a unit test. The files are Google Docs and Google Slides. The cover also lists real primary sources and nine unique activities.

items.title: American Revolution & Constitution Unit Bundle
items.summary: A complete U.S. History unit on the American Revolution and the Constitution for grades 9-12.
items.description:
American Revolution & Constitution Unit Bundle is a complete U.S. History unit for grades 9-12. The cover marks it for South Carolina USHC Standard 1.

Ten lessons run from the taxes after 1763 to the Constitution. Lesson 1, No Tax Without a Vote, asks why new British taxes turned loyal colonists into protesters. Lesson 6, Shays' Rebellion and the Constitutional Convention, 1786-1787, asks what the convention made instead. A checkpoint asks whether July 1776 was remembered, using a painting of the Declaration of Independence, and who is standing and who is seated.

The bundle includes ten lessons, an 8-bit slide deck and a plain-font slide deck, student packets, a DBQ, and a unit test. The files are Google Docs and Google Slides. The cover also lists real primary sources and ten unique activities.

items.title: Expansion & Sectionalism Unit Bundle
items.summary: A complete U.S. History unit on expansion and sectionalism, 1803-1860, for grades 9-12.
items.description:
Expansion & Sectionalism Unit Bundle is a complete U.S. History unit for grades 9-12, covering 1803-1860. The cover marks it for South Carolina USHC Standard 2.

Ten lessons follow the country as it grew and split over who held power. Lesson 4, Jacksonian Democracy, the Bank and Nullification, is one of them. A checkpoint uses John Gast's 1872 painting, American Progress, and asks students to find the large figure in the center and where the work is. Another checkpoint is a class tally: predict before the reveal which way the class will go.

items.title: Civil War & Reconstruction Unit Bundle
items.summary: A complete U.S. History unit on the Civil War and Reconstruction for grades 9-12.
items.description:
Civil War & Reconstruction Unit Bundle is a complete U.S. History unit for grades 9-12. The cover marks it for South Carolina USHC Standard 2.

Ten lessons run from the breakup of the Union through the amendments that followed the war. Lesson 1, House Divided, asks why the election of one man led seven states to leave the Union. Lesson 8, The 13th, 14th and 15th Amendments, asks what those amendments changed. A checkpoint uses a Thomas Nast cartoon from 1876 and asks what the cartoon shows, who has a whip and a pistol of threats, and what choice the artist says voters face.

The bundle includes ten lessons, an 8-bit slide deck and a plain-font slide deck, student packets, a DBQ, and a unit test. The files are Google Docs and Google Slides. The cover also lists real primary sources and ten unique activities.

items.title: World War I Unit Bundle
items.summary: A complete U.S. History unit on World War I for grades 9-12.
items.description:
World War I Unit Bundle is a complete U.S. History unit for grades 9-12. The cover marks it for South Carolina USHC Standard 4.

Nine lessons follow the war from the 1914 spark that pulled Europe in, through the United States trying to stay out, to how the government persuaded Americans to support the war. One lesson is a mission briefing on how the war started. Lesson 4, Selling the War: Propaganda and the Press, asks how that message was built. Students judge the choice later in the unit.

The bundle includes nine lessons, an 8-bit slide deck and a plain-font slide deck, student packets, answer keys, a DBQ, a unit test, and a study guide. The files are Google Docs and Google Slides.

items.title: Roaring Twenties, Depression & New Deal Unit Bundle
items.summary: A complete U.S. History unit on the Twenties, the Depression, and the New Deal, 1920-1941, for grades 9-12.
items.description:
Roaring Twenties, Depression & New Deal Unit Bundle is a complete U.S. History unit for grades 9-12, covering 1920-1941. The cover marks it for South Carolina USHC Standard 4.

Ten lessons run from the boom of the 1920s through the crash and the New Deal. Lesson 5, Causes of the Stock Market Crash of 1929, opens with Black Tuesday and asks what caused the crash and what it set off. A checkpoint uses the signing of the Social Security Act on August 14, 1935, and asks what old-age benefits did and why the law is called a reform.

The bundle includes ten lessons, an 8-bit slide deck and a plain-font slide deck, student packets, a DBQ, and a unit test. The files are Google Docs and Google Slides. The cover also lists real primary sources and ten unique activities.
